results.answer: The maximum 10-minute farm output recorded was 12.36 MW, occurring on 2018-01-04 at 17:40.

The Siemens SWT-2.3-VS-82 model datasheet lists one standard hub height (80 m, with site-specific options), one rotor size (82.4 m), and one turbulence category (IEC Class IA). No alternative sizes or classes are mentioned for this model.
The Kelmarsh wind farm came into commercial operation on 15 April 2016. No decommissioning date is listed in the available data.
The best performing turbine is Penmanshiel 13 with a capacity factor of 0.3161. The worst performing turbine is Penmanshiel 07 with a capacity factor of 0.2163.
The global wake effect is estimated at 7.8 % of the annual energy yield.
The turbine shuts down at 25 m/s and has a custom-built, three-stage planetary-helical gearbox.
The long-term P50 annual energy production estimate is 76.326 GWh and the P90 estimate is 74.761 GWh, based on the monthly linear method.
Turbine 4 has the largest static yaw misalignment at about 18.5 degrees, but the OpenOA estimate is marked inconclusive, meaning it may not be reliable.

Penmanshiel 11 had the most forced-outage hours (726.5). The main cause was “Emergency stop base box” (716.2 hours), followed by “Externally stopped” (3.7 hours) and “Repeating error BP52” (2.7 hours).

The longest downtime was 548.2 hours on turbine 1 caused by a timeout brake closed. Turbine 2 also had a 167.1-hour timeout brake closed event. Turbine 6 had a 28.4-hour forced outage due to maximum grid frequency.
Windward’s rotor diameter is 82 m, while the manufacturer’s datasheet specifies 82.4 m, so it does not match.

The manufacturer offers the **EnergyUp Full Power Curve Advanced** upgrade, raising Annual Energy Production by **up to 5%** and increasing the turbine’s rated power to 2.2 MW (MM82/MM92) or 2.15 MW (MM100). This upgrade requires only a software update and is compatible with MM82, MM92, and MM100 turbines equipped with a Bachmann Controller.

In the ScotWind leasing round, applicants must submit a detailed development budget, nearby windfarm tenants documentation, information about funding organisations, and statements of commitment from the lead and sole applicant or project partners at board level. These documents ensure the project's financial viability and commitment to proceed.

The Hollandse Kust (zuid) tender sites reported water depths of 18.1 m to 27.9 m for HKZWFS I and 18.8 m to 26.6 m for HKZWFS II, with a long-term mean wind speed of 9.44 ± 0.38 m/s at 100 m above sea level.

The best turbine, HillOfTowie_18, shows a peak Cp of 0.5995, which is above the Betz limit of 0.593. This is physically impossible and indicates an anomaly with the nacelle anemometer rather than true performance.
